summary: Founder stabilisation sprint retest of MOD Operations → Quotations + MODService customer quotes. The review request I received was cut off (about 6k characters missing), so I tested the sprint diff in commit c6540854: server-side site truth, idempotency, revision guard, structured commercial exceptions, validity settings/extension/expiry guard, Sage number, notify dry-run, handover set-up, retired CRM endpoints and the light-theme fix. BACKEND: the existing suites test_mod_quotes_http.py + test_mod_ops_quotes.py passed 26/26. My new suite test_mod_quotes_stabilisation_iter316.py passed 14/17; the 3 failures are real bugs: (1) HIGH, concurrent revisions duplicate the option set; (2) extend-validity accepts a non-date; (3) handover set-up accepts a non-date start_date. FRONTEND (1920x1080, all end-to-end flows pass): manager approves with a commercial-exception reason (a 422 toast lists the unverified line first), records Sage ref QT77001, publishes (valid until +30d), Notify shows the mismatch error, then a dry-run toast 'Test mode: no email was sent' with a 'customer notification dry run' history entry and NO real email. Customer portal: the quotes panel is now dark (bg rgb(27,28,29), data-theme=dark), so the HIGH contrast bug from iteration 315 is FIXED. View line table, Choose option, authorise form, then the chosen option is highlighted with 'Your chosen option — awaiting Pulse Fitness check'. Manager Verify & accept, then Service handover, set-up with date, then 'Type A (active)'. The rep wizard (manual row, sor-2 ×2 A) sends one POST with idempotency_key and lands on the draft. The rep sees no Schedule of Rates tab. DATA INTEGRITY: the preview's live Schedule B rate card is NOT the real workbook (see rca).

critical.issue: Revision optimistic-lock does not work. 3 concurrent PUTs on one draft all returned 200 and left 6 current quotes (A,A,A,B,B,B) in the group. Cause: the guard update_one({id, revision, status}, {$set: {revising_batch: batch}}) does not change revision/status, so every concurrent request matches, and each then supersedes the same old_ids and promotes its own batch. Fix: add 'revising_batch': None (or a version counter $inc) to the guard filter, and clear it at the end; or bump the revision atomically in the guard.

The preview rate card is sourced from a SYNTHETIC test workbook ('Schedule B import sor.xlsx (sha256 0b74e65f7d1a)', approved by 'MOD Sales Manager (test)', version SOR-2026-01-01-711c77). Only 19 rate entries are present vs 56 in the real schedule_b_sor.xlsx list. 3 rates differ from the real Schedule B: sor-14 A £99 vs £72.56, sor-26 A £50 vs £145.12, sor-27 A £60 vs £145.12. ZERO price lists are in 'live' status: the real list SOR-2026-11-25-a68b9b is 'superseded'. Cause: the test_mod_quotes_http.py mgr fixture and test_mod_ops_quotes.py import and approve synthetic SOR on the shared preview DB. Teardown restores rate-card rows from a snapshot that was already synthetic, and never restores price-list status. The http fixture also never deletes its price list. So 'Schedule B rates live in preview, tested and approved' is not true right now.

minor.issue: valid_until is a free str. 'not-a-date' returns 200 and is written to all visible quotes. It compares as a string ('n' > '2'), so assert_quote_current never treats it as expired. The UI uses window.prompt with no validation. Validate with a date type (pydantic date).

start_date 'rubbish' returns 200. It creates an active Type A mod_service_contract with start_date='rubbish' and annual_visit.proposed_date='rubbish'. Same applies to CommercialException.valid_until (a str compared to today). Use the date type.

_set_status and the 'not_selected' update_many only exclude 'superseded'. Quotes in 'failed_staging' or 'staging' for the same group (left by a failed revise) would be flipped to draft, pending_approval or not_selected, and become 'current' again in _quotes(). Use status $nin HIDDEN_STATUSES consistently.

test_mod_ops_quotes.py leaves orphan 'failed_staging' crm2_quotes from earlier runs (PFQ-000130/131/164/165/190/191, groups that do not exist). I removed only the pair my run created (PFQ-000216/217).
The search text goes straight into $regex without re.escape (regex injection/ReDoS; '(' gives 500-prone patterns).

After recording Sage QT77001 before publishing, the PDF and filename use QT77001, but the customer portal card, staff auth queue and handover still show internal PFQ-000240. The references the customer sees are inconsistent.

issues: When a site has several quotation groups, every card has the identical heading 'Maintenance quotations — compare your options' with no date, revision or reference to tell them apart.
Tab counter changes Quotes (4) to (3) after authorising; it's unclear what is being counted.
Extend validity uses two window.prompt dialogs (free-text date) instead of a shadcn date picker and dialog.
Commercial-exception 'valid until', handover 'Commencement' and the customer 'mod-auth-date' use the native <input type=date> instead of the shadcn calendar.
Rep sees the 'Customer authorisations' tab with Verify & accept / Not sufficient buttons, but the API returns 403 for reps. Hide or disable these for non-managers.

action_items: HIGH: Fix the revise race in revise_group. The guard filter must exclude in-flight revisions (revising_batch None or an atomic revision bump). Re-run test_concurrent_revise_no_duplicates.

HIGH: Restore the real Schedule B as the live price list in preview: re-import and approve schedule_b_sor.xlsx (sha e61d0056…). Then change the test fixtures so they no longer approve synthetic SOR on the shared DB, or fully snapshot and restore both mod_sor_rate_card AND mod_sor_price_lists status and delete their own price lists and history rows.
Validate dates (pydantic date) in ExtendIn.valid_until, SetupIn.start_date and CommercialException.valid_until. Replace the window.prompt extend flow with a date picker.
Use status $nin HIDDEN_STATUSES in _set_status and in the not_selected update in verify_authorisation.
Decide which reference the customer sees once a Sage number is recorded, and show it consistently in the portal card, auth queue and handover.
critical_code_review_comments: mod_ops_quotes.py is 963 lines (>700). Split it into routes for groups, workflow, authorisations, handover and rates.
set_sage_ref uses the _sales dependency only: any rep can stamp a Sage number. Confirm this is intended.

Idempotency create path: the find-then-insert pre-check plus the unique index is correct (4 concurrent creates returned one group). But on DuplicateKeyError the losing batch's quotes stay as orphan failed_staging rows with no group.
Notify: the dry-run path still builds base64 PDF attachments when attach_pdfs is set, before checking live. That's harmless but wasted work. The dry-run correctly does not set notified_revision.
ModQuoteWizard uses crypto.randomUUID(), which is unavailable on non-secure (http) origins. Add a fallback.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of exercised flows (staff approve/exception/sage/publish/notify-dry-run/auth-accept/handover-setup, customer view/choose/authorise, rep wizard)

rca of the issue: Revise race: in revise_group the compare-and-set filter {id, revision, status} stays true for every concurrent request, because the $set only writes revising_batch. Repro: 3 parallel PUT /groups/{gid} on a draft all return 200, and GET shows 6 current quotes. Mitigation: filter on revising_batch None and $set it atomically (then clear it), or $inc a lock version. Rate-card pollution: the fixtures in test_mod_quotes_http.py (mgr) and test_mod_ops_quotes.py call /rates/import-preview + /approve with synthetic_sor_bytes(). approve_rates sets every other list to superseded and overwrites rate_a/rate_b, and teardown restores only rate-card rows from its snapshot. Repeated runs left the synthetic version as the baseline and no live list.
